question:
Which figure from the given options would replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62f1732b8cbc29226d4b5bc1a13463b1e02359770e05d1bffbc802a71bd857e5.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step 1: " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/679254a27be1c27b10cab80b486acf41c1740ec440cff7337685628078d4acbf.png] and [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd10d80bfd81be2403e1e448146094f528850695b8c495d5526f081abce7f1e3.png] " are exchanging their position diagonally and opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9680b319abb503966d0306a45aed5e4ba1e48cba6cbd72a5c03d289c8ae75d1a.png] 

Step 2: " T and O" are exchanging their positions vertically in upward and downward direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa2e779fbec5135e6c880c4a20afa95bf743f9f9dc68d38f9a37fb3d3d8ab052.png] 

Step 3: In middle of the every image in series there is new element introduced.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56e17f94390b805f03643faa45352045136e49e6d1a0eb366048c96b66ba3ce2.png] 

So, image 5 will be replace the question mark in the given series.

Hence, the correct answer will be*** 'Option 3'.***
